review_observations.result: The registry supplies exactly the four current ordinary modules. Source::local retains the reserved std prefix. Shared import resolution searches target declarations and public visibility, so importing hadamard2 into reflection does not re-export it; nonzero2 remains private. No retired-module alias or special semantic admission is introduced.

The unchanged F4 circuit column for input (a,b), output (v,u), has coefficient i^(a*v)*(-1)^(b*v+a*u)/2. This equals positive exp(2*pi*i*(a+2*b)*(v+2*u)/4)/2. F8 similarly has exponent a*v+2*b*v+4*c*v+2*a*w+4*b*w+4*a*u modulo 8 for output ((v,w),u), equal to (a+2*b+4*c)*(v+2*w+4*u) modulo 8. The Reference preserves positive phase, little-endian axes, included reversal and exact original tuple trees.

nonzero2 is zero only at 00. Computing it, applying Z, and uncomputing therefore describes diag(+1,-1,-1,-1)=2|00><00|-I; conjugating by H tensor H gives 2|++><++|-I with the documented scalar sign. The same protected-computed body and private predicate are retained; this review does not separately prove the checker cleanup/preservation obligation.

measure_x consumes its owner with branch <b|H. measure_z2 consumes both owners and retains left/right result order. The zero meter in parity_zz accumulates a xor b by two unchanged CNOTs and is consumed by measurement, yielding branch projector (I+(-1)^s Z_a Z_b)/2 while retaining both original data owners and within-sector coherence. Docs require distinct owners without requiring separability and include arbitrary external references.

The complete A001-A003 module is byte-identical to the former std arithmetic module. Its documented +1 permutations, modular wrap, retained addend, all-space value-15 fixed point, output route (d,a,b,c), tuple shapes and no-auxiliary/no-measurement contracts remain intact. No reserved parameterized arithmetic identity is represented as an implemented callable API.

The Reference and STDLIB distinguish source checking, bounded tests, actual-IR conformance, source preservation and human specification review; reservations are not delivered families. They explicitly exclude generic QFT from the current scope and claim no new QS/PR/RS/EXACT discharge or constitutional guarantee.
